Heart health support

Healthy Heart Program

The Healthy Heart Program focuses on prevention, education, and lifestyle management for patients looking to reduce cardiovascular risk or recover after a cardiac procedure.

This program is overseen by Dr. Sina Alipour, a cardiologist who works at multiple Fraser Health hospitals, including Burnaby Hospital, Royal Columbian Hospital, and Surrey Memorial Hospital.

What to Expect

  • A technologist will perform either an electrocardiogram (ECG) or an exercise stress test.
  • This helps assess your current heart health, fitness level, and any physical limitations.
  • After the test, you will meet with Dr. Alipour to review your results and discuss whether the program is right for you.
